situation (example wording): "calculate the percent change in violent crime rates for Minneapolis, MN 2024-2025", "percent change in the violent crime rate in Chicago, IL from 2024-2025", "calculate percent change in violent crime rates from 2024-2025 for the state of Colorado"
what the app does today: Declined ("I couldn't use \"percent\""), or answered as a rate series with the percent change left out.
proposed behavior: A change in a rate between two years is answered like a change in a count: "Chicago, Illinois: violent crimes per 100,000, 2024 against 2025.", then "539.8 in 2024 and 420.4 in 2025: a change of -119.4 (-22.1%)." The change is in points per 100,000 and the percent change is on the published rates. A dash between the years ("2024-2025") reads as "from 2024 to 2025", and "for the state of Colorado" reads as Colorado. One place, two years, one crime or the violent total.
exact default or choices offered: As for a change in a count.
why: Jeff 2026-11-18 (through the coordinator): quick reader fix for period comparison ("percent change in violent crime rates 2024-2025").
test cases: scripts/test-nibrs-historical.ts ("A change in a rate"), scripts/test-nibrs-shadow-reading.ts (a dash between the years).
